newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cortecs jumps on good broker report in UK.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs jumps on good broker report in UK.

text.p: The shares of biotechnology group Cortecs International Ltd rose sharply from the open on Thursday after a broker report pushed up the group's British stock 45 pence to 282 pence in London on Wednesday.
At 10.12 a.m (0012 GMT), Cortecs shares were 75 cents or 14.7 percent higher at A$5.85 on turnover of 10,905 shares.
The report from Nomura analyst Nick Woolf said the company's share price could double if news due shortly on one of its leading drugs is positive.

Cortecs is expected to announce the results of a key European Phase III trial on Macritonin, a new drug for treating the bone-wasting illness, osteoporosis, at the end of next week or early the week after.
